title: Neglect shows in the result
literal_meaning: Through the hand’s idleness, the moustache is crooked.
explanation: A small task left undone leaves a visible result. The source extends the image to work stalled through lack of effort; it does not make every unfinished task a moral failure.
meaning_odia: ହାତ ନଲଗାଇଲେ ନିଶ ବଙ୍କା ରହିଯିବା ପରି, ଛୋଟ କାମ ଅବହେଳିତ ହେଲେ ତାହାର ଫଳ ଦିଶେ। କରିହେବା କାମକୁ ପକାଇ ରଖିବାକୁ ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଟିପ୍ପଣୀ କରେ। ତେବେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଅସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କାମ ଅଳସୁଆମିରୁ ହୁଏନାହିଁ; ସମୟ ଓ ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟର ସୀମା ବି ଥାଇପାରେ।
usage_example: A loose cupboard handle stays loose because a simple repair is repeatedly postponed. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The moustache is the domestic image in the wording, not a rule about gender or proper appearance.
